settings.title: Settings
settings.host_pattern: Must be a valid fully qualified domain name
settings.host_format: Must be a valid fully qualified domain name
settings.admin_intro: Snipe-IT is installed with this super user on the first save, so its web installer is never open to the network. The password is not stored by NS8.
settings.admin_user_invalid: Use letters, digits and . _ @ - (2 to 100 characters)
settings.ldap_enabled: Login with a user domain or LDAP server
settings.ldap_intro: Users log in to Snipe-IT with their directory account; Snipe-IT creates the user on the first login, without permissions until a super user grants them. Local accounts, like the super user, keep working. A daily import adds the directory users in advance.
settings.site_name_helper: Shown in the Snipe-IT header. Default: Snipe-IT
settings.mail_from_helper: Mails go through the cluster smarthost. Without one, Snipe-IT writes them to its log.
settings.timezone_helper: Times in Snipe-IT are shown and entered in this zone. Snipe-IT itself has no setting for it.
settings.timezone_unknown: Choose a time zone of the list
settings.timezone_pattern: Choose a time zone of the list
settings.timezone_change: Saving converts all stored times, the history of changes among them, from {from} to {to}. Snipe-IT is stopped meanwhile. Times inside texts, like the old and new values of a change, stay as they are. Back up the instance first.
settings.first_name_attribute_helper: Snipe-IT reads the first name from one attribute only and needs one. Choose the given name only if every user of the directory has one: the daily import skips users without it. Users created in NethServer have no given name. Applied at the next login or import.
settings.control_characters: Line breaks and control characters are not allowed
settings.ldap_inactive: Snipe-IT could not prepare the directory login (e.g. the group does not exist or the server certificate is not valid), so only local accounts can log in. The reason is in the log of the snipeit-app service.
settings.admin_user_pattern: Line breaks and control characters are not allowed
settings.admin_email_pattern: Line breaks and control characters are not allowed
settings.site_name_pattern: Line breaks and control characters are not allowed
settings.mail_from_pattern: Line breaks and control characters are not allowed

ldap_login.no_domains: This cluster has no user domain yet. Add one in Domains and users, or enter an LDAP server.
ldap_login.group_helper: Only members of this group may log in (nested groups count). Empty: every user of the domain. Active Directory only.
ldap_login.group_custom_helper: Group name or DN; only its members may log in. Empty: every user found under the base DN. Active Directory only.
ldap_login.custom_intro: Only needed for a directory that is not a user domain of this cluster. NS8 can also add an external AD/LDAP as a user domain (Domains and users): then it shows up above and no credentials are stored here.
ldap_login.tls_verify_off: The certificate is not checked: someone in the network path could read the passwords. Only for tests or a trusted network.
ldap_login.bind_password_helper: Password of the service account; stored outside the module environment.
ldap_login.secret_is_set: A password is stored — leave blank to keep it.
ldap_login.ldap_domain_unknown: This user domain does not exist in the cluster
ldap_login.start_tls_with_ldaps: StartTLS is only for ldap:// URLs
ldap_login.ldap_group_requires_ad: A login group needs an Active Directory (memberOf)
ldap_login.control_characters: Line breaks and control characters are not allowed
ldap_login.ldap_domain_pattern: Line breaks and control characters are not allowed
ldap_login.ldap_group_pattern: Line breaks and control characters are not allowed
ldap_login.ldap_url_pattern: Line breaks and control characters are not allowed
ldap_login.ldap_base_dn_pattern: Line breaks and control characters are not allowed
ldap_login.ldap_bind_dn_pattern: Line breaks and control characters are not allowed
